authorDispositions.disposition: ExportImage with type=gif or type=webm is rejected explicitly while Animated GIF/WebM stay outside the authorized surface; no silent no-op
the v1 fallback also filters Animated GIF besides STL, Collada, HTML Collada and Dynamic Worksheet

screen-anchored -> export-canvas/presentation anchored, never screen position -> live-view world coordinate -> export authority; keep the presentation position relative to the output canvas where technically sustainable, clipped normally outside the canvas; if the backend cannot preserve this without turning presentation into geometry or materially widening scope, stop and report evidence for an author decision
MANUAL is defined initially through a dialog of world-coordinate bounds; no drag gesture required in B

the initial UI may expose the MANUAL definition from Graphics 1 only; ExportArea and the shared service do not hard-code Graphics 1 as semantic identity, keep an explicit sourceViewId and stay architecturally valid for any supported 2D view; EXPORT_POINTS may be resolved for the corresponding 2D source view; 3D-view export stays entirely outside B and unchanged
Ctrl+Shift+C runs the graphics copy directly through the common service and the same ExportArea authority; no Picture dialog; not a second authority
PSTricks, PGF/TikZ and Asymptote keep their upstream area behavior, including selectionRectangle, until C, as an explicitly documented temporary inconsistency; B does not change that semantics

PDF exactness cannot be obtained by silent rounding or truncation; if the PDF backend cannot represent the required physical size with the exactness of the B contract, stop, characterize the limitation and request an author decision before any approximation; no silent conversion of a fractional point size to an integer size
if --export cannot resolve a valid export area or produce a valid output, it fails explicitly with a non-zero status and leaves no empty file as an apparently valid result

observationPrecisions.precision: the preview appears when Save is run from the Picture export window, in the right-hand panel of the file name and path dialog; it is generated during the save flow of the pending export, not a previously existing file; B reproduces the exact flow and establishes which file-chooser mode and route generate it
observationPrecisions.contract: save-dialog generated preview effective visibility == final export effective visibility
forbiddenResolutions: presenting it as the preview of an earlier file
a second independent render route with different semantics

observationPrecisions.precision: B re-characterizes its effect on preview and export; no silent change to the general layer semantics of the normal view; if widening is required, document and defer or request an author decision
